plan: Since this is effectively a second-price auction (the ascending clock mechanism means I pay the second-highest bid if I win), the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. Bidding my value ensures I win whenever my value exceeds the competitors' bids, and I pay only the second-highest bid, which is always profitable or break-even. Bidding higher risks overpaying; bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. Thus, I will bid exactly $36, my true value, to maximize expected profit.
